lines.trans: Chen! Where did this gleaming blue-and-brass square tin box come from?!
Picked it up at the hardware store on Thursday afternoon, just in case.
Wait—were you already planning a brand-new time capsule two days ago, Chen?!
That hollow pocket under the third courtyard flagstone is already lined with sturdy brick.

words.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

lines.trans: Such careful brickwork—would it not be a shame to leave it sitting empty for the next thirty years?

words.gloss: from now on, in the future

lines.trans: My thoughts precisely: pure practical upkeep, with zero sentimentality.
Zero sentiment, says the man who already cut a neat square of fresh yellow beeswax cloth!
Watch your teasing, Qing, or you will lose the job of writing the lid label.
Oh, please let me write the label! What year and message should we put on top?
Write: Opened with friends in May—please open again thirty summers down the road.
Who gets to pick which treasures go into our new courtyard capsule tonight?
Call Mei, Teacher Song, and the brothers in here—everyone adds one heartfelt keepsake from this week.

Zero sentiment, says the man who already cut a neat square of fresh yellow beeswax cloth!

Oh, please let me write the label! What year and message should we put on top?

examples.text: 工作上没什么特别的事情发生，就是十二歌王有一件事情我觉得有点不妥。
examples.trans: Nothing unusual happened at work, except there was one detail on Twelve Singers that felt slightly off to me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial adverb yíkuài ('together').

examples.text: 他能跟她一块成长。
examples.trans: He can grow alongside her together.

examples.text: 周末咱们一块去看电影吧。
examples.trans: Let us go see a movie together this weekend.

examples.text: 杏子姐，我到公司才不到一年就升职这么快，我是咱们史上升职最快的吗？
examples.trans: Xingzi, I've been at the company less than a year and got promoted so fast — am I the fastest promotion in company history?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎnr. Erhua quantifier/adverb 一 ('one') + 点儿 ('little bit'); used after adjectives (低一点儿 'a tiny bit flat') or before 也不/都没 ('not at all').

examples.text: 那根高音钢丝听起来还稍微低一点儿，再调一下吧。
examples.trans: That treble steel string still sounds a tiny bit flat; let's tune it a touch more.

examples.text: 水性的花园油漆气味很小，走廊里一点儿也不呛人。
examples.trans: Water-based garden paint has very little odour and isn't pungent in the hallway at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Formal preposition/conjunction yǔ ('with; and').

examples.text: 他不宜与艺人见面。
examples.trans: He should not meet with artists.

examples.text: 这事与你无关。
examples.trans: This matter has nothing to do with you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个东西 ('a thing / item').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎi. Everyday verb for purchasing goods; contrasts in tone with 卖 (mài 'sell').

examples.text: 看我的！快说要买什么。
examples.trans: Watch me! Tell me quickly what to buy.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 十二歌王第三季将于下个月重新启幕，我们将融入全新的节目改版。
examples.trans: Season Three of Twelve Singers premieres next month, featuring a brand-new revamped competition format.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ jīn diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家五金店 ('a hardware store').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个人 ('a person').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天晚上 ('this evening').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

以防万一.gloss: just in case; to guard against the unexpected

meanings.en: just in case; to guard against the unexpected
meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ fáng wàn yī. Four-character idiom 以防 ('in order to guard against') + 万一 ('one in ten thousand / an unforeseen contingency').

examples.text: 幸好你多烤了两盘热乎乎的肉桂卷以防万一！
examples.trans: Good thing you baked two extra trays of warm cinnamon rolls just in case!

examples.text: 出门以前带上一把雨伞吧，以防万一下午下雨。
examples.trans: Take an umbrella before heading out, just in case it rains this afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎ. Colloquial fusion of 两个, never followed by 个 (我们俩 'the two of us').

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiōng dì. Measure word (量词): 对 (duì), e.g. 一对兄弟 ('a pair of brothers').

examples.text: 宋老师，快多讲讲梧桐巷那两兄弟吧！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, tell me more about those two brothers on Wutong Lane!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

related.gloss: a pair of brothers (measure word 对)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn. Action verb specifically for cutting with two-bladed scissors, shears, or clippers.

examples.text: 别剪那根绿藤条，把它放到花架上吧。
examples.trans: Don't cut that green vine; lift it onto the trellis.

examples.text: 小晴从院子里剪了两枝新鲜薄荷。
examples.trans: Qing snipped two sprigs of fresh mint from the courtyard.

meanings.en: friend; fellow enthusiast (also a suffix for hobby mates)
meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Appears standalone in concise written phrases (与友同启) and in compounds like 茶友 (tea friend) or 朋友.

examples.text: 梧桐巷的每一位街坊，旁边坐的都是同好茶友或者有共同爱好的人！
examples.trans: Every neighbor from Wutong Lane sits beside someone who shares their favorite tea or hobby!

examples.text: 老友相聚在院子树下，喝着薄荷茶聊了一整晚。
examples.trans: Old friends gathered beneath the courtyard tree, drinking mint tea and talking all evening.

meanings.note: Verb fā ('issue / release / post').

examples.text: 辛惠美发了新歌！
examples.trans: Xin Huimei released a new song!

examples.text: 我给你发了消息。
examples.trans: I sent you a message.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě. Adds emphatic warmth before an adjective/verb, or means 'but'.

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 今天外面的风可真大。
examples.trans: The wind outside today is really strong.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě xī. Expresses sympathetic regret.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 真可惜，最后一盘柠檬蛋糕刚卖完。
examples.trans: What a pity—the last plate of lemon cake just sold out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng. Combines with 一 + measure word to mean 'the very same' (同一个 'the same one').

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? Right inside that very same house?

meanings.note: Locative noun hòu ('afterwards; behind').

examples.text: 您看完修改后的方案觉得如何？
examples.trans: What do you think after reading the revised plan?

examples.text: 许久后我才明白他的良苦用心。
examples.trans: Only much later did I understand his good intentions.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.en: to open or unseal (a box, letter, or era); to start
meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ. Concise literary verb used on inscriptions, letters, and time-capsule notes (e.g. 与友同启, opened together with friends).

examples.text: 就写：五月与友同启——请于三十个夏天后再开。
examples.trans: Write: Opened with friends in May—please open again thirty summers down the road.

examples.text: 周经理轻轻启开那个铜盒，里头整整齐齐放着旧照片。
examples.trans: Zhou gently unsealed the brass box, revealing old photographs neatly arranged inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yā. Expresses mild dismay or sudden surprise.

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎ. Combines with a measure word to ask 'which?' (哪个 'which one?', 哪间 'which room?').

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.en: conversational ending particle expressing an obvious result or playful warning
meanings.note: Pinyin: luo. Soft, light-toned particle placed at the end of a spoken line to mean 'then that settles it!'

examples.text: 小晴，再开我玩笑，盒盖标签可就不归你写啰。
examples.trans: Watch your teasing, Qing, or you will lose the job of writing the lid label.

examples.text: 既然木头隔条都绑稳了，那咱们就下楼喝茶啰！
examples.trans: Since all the wooden spacers are tied tight, let's head downstairs for tea then!

related.gloss: to belong to; be in charge of

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Sentence-final particle reminding the listener of something natural or obvious.

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 都是老街坊，不用客气嘛。
examples.trans: We are all old neighbors—no need to be so formal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Verb mái ('bury in the ground; plant covertly').

examples.text: 你埋在我身边的眼线。
examples.trans: The informants you planted around me.

examples.text: 把秘密埋在心里。
examples.trans: Bury the secret in one's heart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一整天 ('a whole day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.en: treasured item; cherished keepsake (also affectionate term for a child)
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo bèi. Everyday noun for cherished heirlooms, mementos, or beloved little ones.

examples.text: 谁来挑今晚放进咱们新院子胶囊里的宝贝呢？
examples.trans: Who gets to pick which treasures go into our new courtyard capsule tonight?

examples.text: 老陈把那本写了三十年的牛皮纸账本当成心头宝贝。
examples.trans: Chen treats that thirty-year-old leather-bound ledger like a cherished treasure.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

属实.gloss: to be true; prove factual; belong to

meanings.en: to turn out to be factual; (in 纯属……) to belong purely to
meanings.note: Pinyin: shǔ shí. In Pure-X phrases like 纯属实用, 属 marks classification ('falls purely under the category of practical').

examples.text: 我也是这么想：纯属实用维修，一点儿也不矫情。
examples.trans: My thoughts precisely: pure practical upkeep, with zero sentimentality.

examples.text: 小晴向车站核对过电报以后，确认早班车消息完全属实。
examples.trans: After checking the telegram with the station, Qing confirmed the early-train report was completely accurate.

meanings.en: wouldn't that mean...; isn't it obviously the case that...
meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ bù shì. Expressive rhetorical opener turning a question into 'surely it would be a pity if...!'

examples.text: 这么讲究的砖工，往后三十年一直空着岂不是太可惜了？
examples.trans: Such careful brickwork—would it not be a shame to leave it sitting empty for the next thirty years?

examples.text: 要是没写备份名单，刚才海报掉进水盆里岂不是全乱套了？
examples.trans: Without a backup list, wouldn't everything have gone upside down when the poster fell in the basin?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Noun dǐ (as in 透个底, 'reveal the inside truth').

examples.text: 你就跟我透个底吧，他们谁能赢？
examples.trans: Give me an inside tip — which side is going to win?

examples.text: 充分彩排以后，大家心里都有底了。
examples.trans: After a full rehearsal, everyone felt confident.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.note: Verb guī ('come under someone's charge; return').

examples.text: 从今以后，二部的人归一部现场组管。
examples.trans: From now on, Unit Two staff report to Unit One's floor team.

examples.text: 这间素材房归行政部门管理。
examples.trans: This archive room is managed by administration.

往后.gloss: from now on, in the future

meanings.en: from now on, in the future
meanings.note: Time adverb wǎnghòu ('henceforth, going forward').

examples.text: 往后每周录节目，咱俩就成同事了。
examples.trans: Taping every week from now on makes us colleagues.

examples.text: 往后遇到难题随时可以来总编室找我。
examples.trans: Going forward, drop by my office anytime you hit snags.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.en: want to; would like to; think; miss
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Before a verb, expresses a polite wish ('would like to'); before a noun/person, 'think of / miss'.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Verb tiāo ('choose carefully').

examples.text: 要不然从成熟的制片里挑两个留下来？
examples.trans: Why not pick two seasoned producers to stay on?

examples.text: 主编从十份提案里挑出了最好的一份。
examples.trans: The chief editor picked the best out of ten pitches.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Everyday adjective for new people, items, or beginnings.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

examples.text: 感觉非常好，还要谢谢方老师推荐。
examples.trans: It feels great, and I also want to thank Professor Fang for the recommendation.

examples.text: 院子正中央摆着一张擦得发亮的老榆木方桌。
examples.trans: Right in the center of the courtyard sits a gleaming old elmwood square table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí jiān jiāo náng. Compound 时间 ('time') + 胶囊 ('capsule'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 出远门回家以前，我和您姑姑藏了一个小铁盒时间胶囊。
examples.trans: Before my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.

examples.text: 时间胶囊里装着三十年前的手绘地图和一张旧照片。
examples.trans: Inside the time capsule were a thirty-year-old hand-drawn map and an old photograph.

meanings.note: Friendly workplace farewell míngtiān jiàn.

examples.text: 我先走了，明天见！
examples.trans: I am heading off, see you tomorrow!

examples.text: 大家辛苦了，明天见！
examples.trans: Great work everyone, see you tomorrow!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期 ('a week').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī sì. Literally 'week-day four'; Mainland standard alongside informal 周四 (zhōu sì).

examples.text: 周经理本来想让司机星期四下午送椅子来。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou originally meant to have the driver deliver the chairs on Thursday afternoon.

examples.text: 我们每个星期四晚上都会核对一次账本。
examples.trans: Every Thursday evening we check the account ledger together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn lái. Indicates what was originally planned or true.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biāo qiān. Combines 标 ('mark/sign') + 签 ('inscribed slip/tag'); measure word: 张 (zhāng); verb: 贴标签 ('stick on a label').

examples.text: 睡觉以前，先把那两个神秘白罐子都贴上清楚的大红标签。
examples.trans: Before going to bed, stick clear bright red labels onto both of those mysterious white jars.

examples.text: 贴好“白糖”和“海盐”的标签以后，早上做点心就再也不会拿错了。
examples.trans: Once the 'Sugar' and 'Sea Salt' labels are stuck on, nobody will mix them up during morning baking.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiú. Used for earnest requests (求你了 'please, I beg you!').

examples.text: 老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
examples.trans: Chen, please tell me it was just a tiny bit of air in the pipe!

examples.text: 我求他再给我们一天时间。
examples.trans: I pleaded with him to give us one more day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Used for refilling tea or politely apologizing for causing extra trouble (添麻烦).

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 真不好意思，又给您添麻烦了。
examples.trans: So sorry to have caused you extra trouble again.

examples.text: 王总，开什么玩笑呢？
examples.trans: Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

examples.text: 王总，开什么玩笑呢？
examples.trans: Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Single-character bound/free noun for small boxes (木盒 'wooden box', 盒子 'box'); also a measure word ('a box of').

examples.text: 雪松木盒里整齐地放着一叠旧明信片。
examples.trans: A stack of old postcards sits neatly inside the cedar box.

examples.text: 小晴买了一盒彩色粉笔写咖啡馆黑板。
examples.trans: Qing bought a box of coloured chalk to write on the café blackboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài. Used for stamping an official seal (盖印章) or putting on a lid.

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 文件下面已经盖好了红色印章。
examples.trans: The red official seal has already been stamped at the bottom of the document.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个木头盖子 ('a wooden lid').

examples.text: 开了！老陈，快打开木头盖子！
examples.trans: It's open! Chen, quick, lift the wooden lid!

examples.text: 盖子要小心一点——它已经关了几十年了。
examples.trans: Careful with the lid—it has been closed for decades.

盘.gloss: tray; plate; dish (measure word for trays of baked goods or dishes)

meanings.en: tray; plate; dish (measure word for trays of baked goods or dishes)
meanings.note: Pinyin: pán. Classifier for trays, pans, or plates of food (一盘柠檬挞 'a tray/plate of lemon tart', 四大盘 'four big trays').

examples.text: 四十个柠檬，正好烤四大盘六点钟的杏仁柠檬挞！
examples.trans: Forty lemons works out right to bake four big trays of almond lemon tart for six o'clock!

examples.text: 幸好小美多烤了两盘热乎乎的肉桂卷。
examples.trans: Luckily Mei baked two extra trays of piping-hot cinnamon rolls.

meanings.note: Adjective/noun zhēnxīn ('wholehearted sincerity').

examples.text: 其实林姐她们对你是一片真心。
examples.trans: Truthfully, Lin Jie and her team feel genuine goodwill toward you.

examples.text: 观众总是能感受到创作者的真心。
examples.trans: Viewers can always feel a creator's genuine heart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.en: overly sentimental, fussy, or affected; feigning reluctance
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo qíng. Often used playfully in 一点儿也不矫情 ('not sentimental at all').

examples.text: 我也是这么想：纯属实用维修，一点儿也不矫情。
examples.trans: My thoughts precisely: pure practical upkeep, with zero sentimentality.

examples.text: 老陈嘴上说最怕矫情，手里却早把时间胶囊的黄蜡布剪齐了。
examples.trans: Chen claims he hates being sentimental, yet he already trimmed the yellow beeswax cloth for the time capsule.

砌.gloss: lay bricks or stones; build a wall

meanings.en: lay bricks or stones; build a wall
meanings.note: Pinyin: qì. Architectural verb specifically for building masonry walls with brick, stone, or mortar (砌墙 'build a wall').

examples.text: 办事员说修复一间老阳光房，而不是随便砌一面新墙，简直太聪明了！
examples.trans: The clerk said restoring an old sunroom instead of just bricking up a new wall was downright genius!

examples.text: 小院外面的矮墙是用青灰色的老砖一块一块砌起来的。
examples.trans: The low wall outside the courtyard was laid brick by brick with old blue-grey bricks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵砖墙 ('a brick wall').

examples.text: 老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
examples.trans: Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.

examples.text: 椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
examples.trans: Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.

meanings.en: brickwork or masonry craftsmanship; also a bricklayer
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān gōng. Context clarifies whether it names the finished masonry or the worker.

examples.text: 这么讲究的砖工，往后三十年一直空着岂不是太可惜了？
examples.trans: Such careful brickwork—would it not be a shame to leave it sitting empty for the next thirty years?

examples.text: 老陈砌墙的砖工细致极了，接缝整整齐齐没有一点歪斜。
examples.trans: Chen's brickwork is remarkably fine, with every seam lined up straight and true.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng. Describes an unoccupied room or bare floor.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.en: empty groove, recessed cavity, or hollow pocket
meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng cáo. Measure word: 个 (gè), e.g. 一个空槽 ('an empty recess').

examples.text: 院子第三块青石板底下的空槽，本来就砌好了结实砖墙。
examples.trans: That hollow pocket under the third courtyard flagstone is already lined with sturdy brick.

examples.text: 木头盒盖合上以后，放进石板底下的空槽里正好严丝合缝。
examples.trans: Once closed, the box fits snugly right inside the hollow pocket under the stone.

meanings.note: Ordinal numeral dìsān ('third').

examples.text: 接下来介绍第三季的全面改版计划。
examples.trans: Next we present the full overhaul plan for Season Three.

examples.text: 今晚的第三位竞演歌手即将登台演唱。
examples.trans: Tonight's third competing singer is about to take the stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: suàn. Means 'calculate' or 'count as'.

examples.text: 明天早上八点，你们的第一杯小院咖啡算客栈请客！
examples.trans: And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!

examples.text: 我算了一下，一共十五块钱。
examples.trans: I added it up—fifteen yuan in total.

examples.text: 这是纯啊。
examples.trans: This is pure.

examples.text: 那个纯好。
examples.trans: That pure is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shi. Note first tone jiē + neutral shi ('solidly built').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

meanings.en: to maintain, service, or repair equipment, tracks, or buildings
meanings.note: Pinyin: wéi xiū. Works both as a verb ('repair') and as an event noun ('upkeep').

examples.text: 铁轨维修把他的晚班车改到了下午直达成都的快车上！
examples.trans: Track repairs shifted his evening connection onto the fast afternoon express straight into Chengdu!

examples.text: 老陈每隔几个月就把客栈木门和铁锁仔细维修保养一遍。
examples.trans: Every few months Chen carefully repairs and oils the inn's wooden doors and iron latches.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo chén. Affectionate respectful name for Courtyard Inn's handyman.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

meanings.en: capsule; sealed container (used in 时间胶囊 'time capsule' or medicine)
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo náng. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 粒 (lì, for a pill).

examples.text: 谁来挑今晚放进咱们新院子胶囊里的宝贝呢？
examples.trans: Who gets to pick which treasures go into our new courtyard capsule tonight?

examples.text: 老陈挑了个蓝底黄铜边的方铁盒，专门用来做新的时间胶囊。
examples.trans: Chen picked out a blue-and-brass square tin specifically to serve as the new time capsule.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng là. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài) or 层 (céng). Joins 蜂 ('bee') + 蜡 ('wax').

examples.text: 信封的开口处滴着一圈红色的封印蜂蜡。
examples.trans: The opening of the envelope is dripped with a ring of red sealing beeswax.

examples.text: 老陈用一块天然蜂蜡仔细打磨着木雕。
examples.trans: Chen carefully polished the wood carving with a piece of natural beeswax.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

examples.text: 总编室是个讲究效率的地方。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office is a place that cares about efficiency.

examples.text: 总编室是个讲究效率的地方。
examples.trans: The chief editor's office is a place that cares about efficiency.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句话 ('a sentence / remark').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 我修水管和椅子。人的话得自己修。
examples.trans: I fix water pipes and chairs. People have to fix their own words.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一边 ('one side').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 我们不用电脑，一直用这个大纸本子记账。
examples.trans: We do not use a computer; we always use this big paper ledger to keep accounts.

examples.text: 这个木头小火车是老木匠专门为孩子们做的礼物。
examples.trans: This little wooden train is a gift made specially for the children by the old carpenter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè me. Proximal degree adverb (这么快 'this fast', 这么重 'so heavy').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn lái. Friendly invitation 请进来 ('please come in').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiě. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铁 ('a piece of iron').

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

related.gloss: a piece of iron (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǎn. Describes a blinking indicator light, camera flash, or lightning.

examples.text: 前台电话上的小红灯一直在闪，肯定有新留言。
examples.trans: The little red light on the front-desk phone keeps blinking—there must be a new message.

examples.text: 夜空里的星星一闪一闪的，特别亮。
examples.trans: Stars in the night sky twinkle brightly off and on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.en: dark gray-blue stone paving slab; courtyard flagstone
meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng shí bǎn. Measure word: 块 (kuài), e.g. 第三块青石板 ('the third flagstone').

examples.text: 太精彩了！听听这二十八位邻里在院子青石板上响起的掌声吧——满院子都在鼓掌！
examples.trans: Bravo! Listen to the applause rising from all twenty-eight neighbors across the courtyard flagstones!

examples.text: 梧桐巷下过雨以后，湿润的青石板把红灯笼的影子映得亮晶晶的。
examples.trans: After rain on Wutong Lane, the damp flagstones reflect the red lanterns in a soft shimmer.

meanings.en: effortlessly along the way; picking up or doing something conveniently
meanings.note: Pinyin: shùn shǒu. Common before action verbs: 顺手买 ('grab along the way'), 顺手带 ('bring along').

examples.text: 星期四下午在五金店顺手买的，以防万一嘛。
examples.trans: Picked it up at the hardware store on Thursday afternoon, just in case.

examples.text: 小晴出门寄信时，顺手从路口花店带了一把鲜薄荷回来。
examples.trans: While out mailing a letter, Qing picked up a bunch of fresh mint from the corner flower stall on her way back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng. Describes yellow flowers, brass, or butter.

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 秋天到了，院子里的树叶黄了。
examples.trans: Autumn has arrived, and the courtyard leaves have turned yellow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
